messages.subject: specify user for log file
parts:
Hi,

Is there a configuration directive that can specify not only the location of the log files but also the owner of the log files? At the moment, our shiny server instance is run as root (since the run_as "non-root" doesn't seem to work at the moment); however, we would like the log files to to be readable by a gsu account.

Thanks,
Paul
